description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing submodule configurations in a Git repository, including functions for lookup, parsing, and cache management.

classes.name: submodule
classes.description: Represents a Git submodule with attributes like path, name, URL, fetch mode, ignore policy, branch, update strategy, associated git object ID, and shallow clone recommendation.

classes.name: submodule_tree_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in a submodule tree, including the name entry, associated repository, and submodule configuration.

classes.name: submodule_entry_list
classes.description: A list structure holding multiple submodule tree entries, with count and allocation info.

methods.name: parse_submodule_fetchjobs
methods.description: Parses fetch jobs configuration for submodules.

methods.name: parse_fetch_recurse_submodules_arg
methods.description: Parses the recurse submodules argument for fetch.

methods.name: parse_update_recurse_submodules_arg
methods.description: Parses the recurse submodules argument for update.

methods.name: parse_push_recurse_submodules_arg
methods.description: Parses the recurse submodules argument for push.

methods.name: repo_read_gitmodules
methods.description: Reads the .gitmodules file for a repository.

methods.name: gitmodules_config_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the .gitmodules configuration.

methods.name: submodule_from_name
methods.description: Looks up a submodule by name in a repository at a specific commit or tree.

methods.name: submodule_from_path
methods.description: Looks up a submodule by path in a repository at a specific commit or tree.

methods.name: submodule_free
methods.description: Frees cached submodule data for a repository.

methods.name: config_set_in_gitmodules_file_gently
methods.description: Sets configuration in the .gitmodules file gently.

methods.name: check_submodule_name
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a submodule name.

methods.name: check_submodule_url
methods.description: Validates the URL of a submodule.

methods.name: submodules_of_tree
methods.description: Retrieves all submodules within a given tree, excluding nested submodules.

methods.name: submodule_entry_list_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a submodule entry list.
